base_member_text: [L1013-L1018,L1032-L1105,L1118-L1127] (LOW/input-error-handling) The generic read_v routines and count_lines open/read files without controlled OPEN or READ error reporting, unlike the parameter readers elsewhere in the module.
audit_member_text: [L1003-L1018,L1021-L1105] (MED/unchecked input I/O) The read_v overloads perform external reads without iostat handling, so malformed or short records bypass the module's structured error reporting.

base_member_text: [L819-L912] (MED/optional-argument-contract) setallowednames tests only presence of each name and then dereferences its paired optional integer without verifying that the integer is present, making malformed public calls undefined.
audit_member_text: [L806-L913] (HIGH/optional-argument misuse) setallowednames tests only each optional name aN before dereferencing the independently optional value vN, so legal calls that omit a paired value reference an absent optional argument.

base_member_text: [L238-L300] (MED/index-contract) Legacy-name translation indexes allowed(j) for every old name without enforcing nov<=nv, so a caller that registers more legacy aliases than canonical names reads beyond the allowed array.
audit_member_text: [L238-L300] (HIGH/alias-table bounds) readkey_str maps old option j to allowed(j) without requiring nov<=nv, while the independent allowed/old-name setup APIs permit more old names than allowed names.

base_member_text: [L597-L641] (HIGH/bounds) readkey caches key/value pairs in fixed 1024-element arrays but increments ikey for every line containing '=' without a capacity check, allowing a sufficiently large parameter file to index past both arrays.
audit_member_text: [L585-L643] (HIGH/fixed-cache overflow) readkey stores every line containing '=' into fixed 1024-element keyword/value arrays without checking ikey before incrementing, so a larger parameter file writes out of bounds.

base_member_text: [L57-L149,L152-L235,L238-L322,L326-L381,L384-L462,L465-L543] (MED/mpi-contract) The scalar and vector readers assign results only on xmaster and leave non-master results undefined when bcast is false, but the public interfaces do not constrain bcast=false calls to master-only execution.
audit_member_text: [L106-L149,L194-L235,L274-L322,L358-L380,L420-L462,L501-L543] (MED/undefined MPI result) When bcast is false, all scalar and vector readers assign results only on xmaster, so non-master callers receive undefined function results despite the routines remaining publicly callable on all ranks.

base_member_text: [L1032-L1105] (MED/optional-argument-contract) read_v_9 assumes optional outputs form a contiguous prefix (for example, presence of a8 implies a1 through a7) and dereferences/broadcasts earlier optional arguments without PRESENT checks.
audit_member_text: [L1021-L1105] (HIGH/optional-argument misuse) read_v_9 assumes optional outputs are present contiguously; presence of a higher-numbered argument causes all lower arguments to be read and broadcast even if some were omitted via keywords.

base_member_text: [L106-L114] (HIGH/numeric-parsing) readkey_dbl parses every value with fixed-width F10.0, so numeric text longer than ten columns can be truncated or rejected even though the backing value buffer is much longer.
audit_member_text: [L109-L114] (MED/numeric parsing truncation) readkey_dbl parses through fixed F10.0 format, so only a ten-character field is consumed and longer valid floating-point values can be truncated or rejected.

base_member_text: [L420-L440] (HIGH/input-error-handling) readkey_dblvec handles only negative IOSTAT after list-directed conversion; a positive IOSTAT from an invalid token is ignored and partially undefined vector elements are subsequently range-checked and returned.
[L501-L521] (HIGH/input-error-handling) readkey_intvec likewise ignores positive conversion IOSTAT and proceeds to inspect and return a partially undefined integer vector.
audit_member_text: [L423-L440,L504-L521] (HIGH/ignored conversion error) Both vector readers handle only negative internal-read iostat, so a positive iostat from an invalid token is ignored and partially undefined elements are subsequently range-checked, logged, and returned.

base_member_text: [L624-L636,L1136-L1148] (MED/comment-parsing) The preprocessing routine replaces only non-printable characters and does not remove comments, so any comment text containing '=' is cached as a parameter and later reported as unknown or can interfere with value parsing.

audit_member_text: [L384-L463,L465-L544] (HIGH/vector bounds and undefined tail) The vector readers never require 0<=vlength<=tlength, directly section value_vec(1:vlength), and leave result elements vlength+1:tlength undefined.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: Both vector functions declare a tlength-element result but assign and broadcast only 1:vlength, with no length check or whole-result initialization (L384-L544). Thus the tail is undefined when vlength<tlength, and vlength>tlength overruns the declared result; caller discipline can prevent the overrun but does not initialize the returned tail.

audit_member_text: [L603-L643] (MED/stale file cache) The parameter cache is invalidated only when the filename string changes, so rereading a modified file under the same name returns stale values and stale used-key tracking.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: The saved filename is the sole reload condition, enclosing both file reads and readindex initialization (L597-L643). Replacing or editing the same pathname between calls therefore leaves both cached values and usage bookkeeping from the previous contents.

audit_member_text: [L611-L625] (MED/fixed-unit and unchecked open) readkey uses hard-coded unit 99 for both passes and does not check OPEN status, risking unit collisions and unstructured failures for inaccessible files.

[L762-L804] (HIGH/undefined optional MPI output) parmapply assigns optional parm_str only on xmaster and never broadcasts it, so a present parm_str is undefined on non-master ranks even when parameter broadcasting is enabled.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: parm_str is INTENT(OUT) and its only assignment is inside the xmaster branch; the USEMPI block broadcasts only parm (L769-L802). Broadcasting the local string d through readkey_str does not assign the non-master caller's parm_str.

audit_member_text: [L762-L778] (MED/unchecked default index) parmapply indexes allowednames(idefname) without checking idefname against 1:numallowednames.
[L1136-L1148] (LOW/input corruption) strippedline replaces every byte outside printable 7-bit ASCII with a blank, silently corrupting valid non-ASCII parameter values and filenames.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: strippedline replaces each character code outside 32:126 with a space, and readkey applies it to the entire record before splitting key and value (L628-L635). Consequently non-ASCII bytes inside a value or filename are changed without any diagnostic.

do itab=1,slen
         if (ichar(line(itab:itab))<32 .or. ichar(line(itab:itab))>126) then  ! this is anything not in standard
            ! alphanumeric
            strippedline(itab:itab) = ' '
         else
            strippedline(itab:itab) = line(itab:itab)
